description: Toolchain of the clean-environment replay of replay-2026-10-26 (Parts A and B) in the replay-clean container. replay.sh --require-toolchain <this file> compares the values under 'enforce' exactly and stops with exit status 3 on any difference. The other fields document where each value comes from.

image.image_id_note: Local build of replay-clean/Dockerfile (Docker image config digest). apt package versions are not pinned; the installed set is listed in out/env/tools.txt, so a rebuild can differ in those packages and in its image id while the JDKs, Maven and the commits below are fixed.

maven.via: the Maven wrapper (mvnw, maven-wrapper 3.1.0) of each pinned apache/seatunnel revision; Maven itself is not installed
maven.wrapper_jar: org/apache/maven/wrapper/maven-wrapper/3.1.0/maven-wrapper-3.1.0.jar (sha1 checked against Maven Central's .sha1 by replay.sh)
maven.distribution_zip_note: sha256 ccd67d1e... (enforce.maven_distribution_sha256) is the zip downloaded by the wrapper in the container (out/bundle/logs/partA/maven-version.txt) and in the published runs; its sha1 equals Maven Central's apache-maven-3.8.4-bin.zip.sha1 (checked 2026-10-26).

other_tools: git 2.43.0, curl 8.5.0, GNU patch 2.7.6, GNU bash 5.2; wget not installed (out/env/tools.txt)
